status: H398 all-pair screen frozen before outcomes
design: All36 head pairs, actual and six moment controls, four signed amplitudes. Use exact rational joint law for raw targets and sum of single laws as predictor; audit direct native MLP on first4 sites of every pair/condition/amplitude. Primary contrast log(mean common-scale actual error / mean common-scale moment error). Preserve each source norm and residual angle, not mutual angle or effect size.

gates.native_audit: max relative float32 rational vs direct response error on audit sites <.01
gates.raw_unit99: all144 actual/control unit raw squared relative-error joint upper bounds <.01
gates.weak_candidate: at least one condition with joint144 upper log(actual/control common-scale error)<log(.5)
gates.strong_candidate: at least one condition with joint144 lower log(actual/control common-scale error)>log(2)

selection: Using joint144 intervals, weak actual candidates have upper log error ratio <log(.5); strong actual candidates have lower >log(2). Rank weak by point log ratio ascending and strong descending; select up to2 distinct pairs per category, taking the most extreme condition for each pair. These are discovery candidates requiring fresh confirmation.
